The short version

Capable company for the parts of life that resist a tidy list.

Jasper helps with productivity, communication, scheduling, and personal organization. He works with authorized accounts to turn useful information into sensible next steps.

He is not a public service or a product for general sign-up. Access is limited to his operator and explicitly authorized accounts. A small operation, deliberately kept that way.
